labels.title: Import customers from a CSV
labels.intro: Load the customer list exported by your previous system. Nothing is written until you run the check and then confirm the import. People already in the CRM (same phone, e-mail or company number, or the same plate) are not created twice and are never changed. Marketing consent is NOT taken over: imported customers get no e-mail, WhatsApp or phone mailings until they agree.
labels.confirmImport: Import these customers and cars now?
labels.readError: The file could not be read or the mapping is wrong

reasons.invalid_plate: Plate not valid, car not created
reasons.plate_conflict: Plate already belongs to another customer, not moved
reasons.name_only_key: Only a name to recognise the person by (a repeat import will match it by exact name)
